newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian priest set alight by masked attacker.
newsitem.headline: Italian priest set alight by masked attacker.

text.p: An Italian priest was fighting for his life on Monday after an unknown attacker doused him with petrol and set fire to him as he prayed alone in his church.
Doctors said Father Mario Torregrossa, 52, suffered burns to 40 percent of his body in Sunday's attack at the Roman Catholic Church of San Carlo da Sezze in the town of Acilia, near Rome.
Police said they had no firm lead on the motives for the attack, carried out by a man who hid his face behind a scarf.
Torregrossa had worked with drug addicts, tramps and prostitutes.
The assailant approached the priest from behind as he prayed alone in a chapel of his church early on Sunday, poured petrol on him and lit it with a match, a police spokesman said.
Torregross, who had been alone in the church, was found by another priest alerted by his screams.
